info.brief: The module a project requires to use defold-wrap: `node` and `go` wrap one GUI node or
info.description:
The module a project requires to use defold-wrap: `node` and `go` wrap one GUI node or
game object, or a list of them, so calls on them chain, and `gui_applet` creates an
applet that shows scenes.

parameters.name: node
parameters.doc:
The node, or its id. An id is looked up in `tree` first, then with
`gui.get_node`.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.doc: A table from `gui.clone_tree` or `gui.get_tree` to look an id up in.

elements.name: node
elements.brief: Wraps the node with each id, keyed by the id, from `wrap.node_list.new`.
elements.description: Wraps the node with each id, keyed by the id, from `wrap.node_list.new`.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.doc:
A table from `gui.clone_tree` or `gui.get_tree` to look each id up in
first. An id it lacks, or every id when it is omitted, is looked up with
`gui.get_node`.

elements.name: node
elements.brief: Wraps each node, keyed by its name, from `wrap.node_list.new`.
elements.description: Wraps each node, keyed by its name, from `wrap.node_list.new`.

parameters.name: node
parameters.doc: Each name, paired with a node id or a node.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.doc:
A table from `gui.clone_tree` or `gui.get_tree` to look each id up in
first. An id it lacks, or every id when it is omitted, is looked up with
`gui.get_node`.

elements.name: go
elements.brief: Wraps the game object at each url, keyed by the url, from `wrap.go_list.new`.
elements.description: Wraps the game object at each url, keyed by the url, from `wrap.go_list.new`.

elements.name: go
elements.brief: Wraps each game object, keyed by its name, from `wrap.go_list.new`.
elements.description: Wraps each game object, keyed by its name, from `wrap.go_list.new`.

parameters.name: go
parameters.doc: Each name, paired with a game object url.

elements.brief: Creates an applet on a node, from `wrap.gui_applet.new`, and when given a scene class
elements.description:
Creates an applet on a node, from `wrap.gui_applet.new`, and when given a scene class
shows a new scene of it.

parameters.name: root_node
parameters.doc: The node, or the id `gui.get_node` looks it up by.

elements.name: gui_applet
elements.brief: Creates an applet on a node, from `wrap.gui_applet.new`, and shows a scene built from a
elements.description:
Creates an applet on a node, from `wrap.gui_applet.new`, and shows a scene built from a
plain table of hooks and fields, copied onto a fresh `wrap.gui_scene.extend()`.

parameters.name: root_node
parameters.doc: The node, or the id `gui.get_node` looks it up by.

parameters.name: scene
parameters.doc: The hooks and fields, each hook seeing the scene as `this`.
